fields.name: credits
fields.short: The number of credits used on the message.

fields.name: destination
fields.short: The phone number of the recipient.

fields.name: from
fields.short: The date-time from which you would like matching messages

fields.name: keyword
fields.short: The keyword used in the inbound message

fields.name: limit
fields.short: The maximum number of messages that you would like returned in this call.

fields.name: metadata
fields.short: An array of objects containing metadata key/value pairs that have been saved on messages.

fields.name: sender
fields.short: The sender of the message (this can be the configured sender name for an outbound message or the senders phone number for an inbound message).

fields.name: skip
fields.short: The number of results you would like to ignore before returning messages.

fields.name: status
fields.short: The status of the messages you would like returned (either 'SENT', 'DELIVERED', 'EXPIRED', 'UNDELIVERABLE', 'REJECTED' or 'INCOMING')

fields.name: to
fields.short: The date-time to which you would like matching messages

fields.name: unread
fields.short: In queries for incoming messages ('status' is 'INCOMING'), specify whether you explicitly want unread messages (true) or read messages (false).
